text:
Allerdurchlauchtigster Großmächtigste König
allergnädigster König und Herr!
Schon vor geraumer Zeit hat eine Königliche Regierung zu
Posen die Berichtigung des Tituli possessionis von dem
Fürstlich Hohenlohischen Gütern von Sr Durchlaucht als
nothwendig und eilig abgefordert, worauf des Herrn Fürsten
Durchlaucht die hierzu gefehlten Donazions Urkunden in Ori¬
ginali an Euer Mayestät eingeschikt haben. So sehr nun
Sr Durchlaucht hierbey zur eiligen Berichti¬
gung des Tituli possessionis angestrengt worden sind;
so angelegen sehen seitdem höchst solche der Beendigung dieser
Sache entgegen, und ich bin jetzt Namens meines Herrn
Durchlaucht beauftragt worden Euer Majestät inständigst
um die schleunigste Resignazion des Fisci über die ge¬
sammte Fürstliche Güter in Cujavien und Betschen
allerunterthänigst zu bitten. Ich ersterbe in tief
ster Ehrfurcht
Euer Königlichen Majestät
Betschen den 13ten Februar 1802.
allerunterthänigster
J. Wilhelm Glenck
Fürstl. Hohenl. Bau und Oeco¬
nomie Rath

translation.en:
Most Serene, Most Mighty King, most gracious King and Lord!

Already a considerable time ago a Royal Government at Posen demanded from His Serene Highness the rectification of the titulus possessionis of the princely Hohenlohe estates as necessary and urgent, whereupon His Highness the Prince sent in to Your Majesty the deeds of donation wanting for this purpose in the original. As much, then, as His Serene Highness has been pressed in this matter to the speedy rectification of the titulus possessionis, so earnestly does he since look [uncertain: forward] to the conclusion of this affair, and I have now been charged in the name of His Serene Highness my Lord to beg Your Majesty most humbly and most urgently for the most speedy resignation by the Treasury (Fiscus) of the whole of the princely estates in Cujavia and Betsche. I remain, until death, in deepest reverence

Your Royal Majesty's

Betsche, the 13th of February 1802.

most humble and obedient

J. Wilhelm Glenck, princely Hohenlohe Councillor of Building and Economy

Already a considerable time ago a Royal Government at Posen demanded from His Serene Highness the rectification of the titulus possessionis of the princely Hohenlohe estates as necessary and urgent, whereupon His Highness the Prince sent in to Your Majesty the deeds of donation wanting for this purpose in the original. As much, then, as His Serene Highness has been pressed in this matter to the speedy rectification of the titulus possessionis, so earnestly does he since look [uncertain: forward] to the conclusion of this affair, and I have now been charged in the name of His Serene Highness my Lord to beg Your Majesty most humbly and most urgently for the most speedy resignation by the Treasury (Fiscus) of the whole of the princely estates in Cujavia and Betsche. I remain, until death, in deepest reverence

Your Royal Majesty's

Betsche, the 13th of February 1802.

most humble and obedient

J. Wilhelm Glenck, princely Hohenlohe Councillor of Building and Economy
summary_en: A petition to the King, on behalf of the Prince of Hohenlohe-Ingelfingen, pressing for the Treasury to resign title to the whole of the princely estates in Cujavia and Betsche as quickly as possible. It recalls that a Royal Government at Posen had earlier demanded that the title of possession to the Hohenlohe estates be put right as urgent, and that the Prince accordingly submitted the missing deeds of donation in the original. Signed by J. Wilhelm Glenck, princely Hohenlohe Councillor of Building and Economy.
summary_de: Bittschrift an den König: Die Regierung zu Posen habe schon länger die Berichtigung des titulus possessionis der fürstlich Hohenloheschen Güter verlangt, worauf der Fürst die dazu fehlenden Schenkungsurkunden im Original eingesandt habe. Namens seines Herrn bittet der fürstlich Hohenlohesche Bau- und Wirtschaftsrat J. Wilhelm Glenck um die schnellste Resignation des Fiscus auf sämtliche fürstlichen Güter in Cujavien und Betsche, damit die Sache endlich zum Abschluss kommt.
